QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_34

question.text: During the Liquidation Period of a Cat III AIF scheme, before distribution, the manager is required to arrange bids for a minimum of ______ of the value of unliquidated investments, for the purpose of in-specie distribution:

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 13.6.2: upon receiving investor approval for in-specie distribution, the AIF shall arrange bids for a MINIMUM OF 25% of the value of the unliquidated investments. Dissenting investors exit out of this 25% pool; any unsubscribed bid goes pro-rata to non-dissenters. The Trap: 10% / 50% / 75% are surrounding distractors. 25% is the specified floor. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C/D test the same 25% bid-floor rule. Manager's Pro-Tip: The 25% bid arrangement serves both a price-discovery and a dissent-exit function. If bids fall below 25%, distribution happens at Re. 1 — a sharp incentive for the manager to arrange bids rigorously.
